title: Dynamic E4M3/E5M2 Sensitivity Harness + Safe Fallbacks for Hopper FP8 Enablement
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: ship a robust enablement path for FP8 on Hopper GPUs that uses a dynamic sensitivity harness to pick between E4M3 and E5M2 profiles and provides automated, production-safe fallbacks. This ticket covers the calibration sampler, runtime heuristics for selection, sentinel thresholds to avoid regressions, and a canary rollout/cutover plan. Motivation: previous attempts to flip FP8 globally caused intermittent quality regressions on long-context, low-temp workloads. We need a reproducible harness that (1) measures per-layer activation sensitivity across representative traffic, (2) computes profile confidence scores, (3) wires safe runtime decision logic (prefer E4M3 when safe, fall back to E5M2 or int8/fp16 otherwise), and (4) integrates with telemetry and rollback automation.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness generates stable per-layer sensitivity reports for 95% of models in the golden suite within 2 hours for 1M-sample seed
Automatic selector chooses E4M3 for models where delta in key eval metrics <= 0.5% relative to baseline across held-out prompt set
Runtime fallback triggers when live drift metric exceeds configured hysteresis (default 3 consecutive windows) and automatically routes traffic to E5M2 or FP16 with no >1% error rate increase
Canary rollout shows no customer-visible QoS regression across 100K requests (latency and top-k accuracy) and telemetry dashboards are populated
End-to-end lifecycle covered by tests: unit tests for selector logic, integration test for sampler to storage, and golden-suite nightly regression job passes
implementation_steps: Design: define sensitivity score formula (per-layer KL + max-activation ratio) and confidence threshold calibration
Harness: implement activation sampler in calibration-service that collects per-op activation histograms and tail statistics
Offline analysis: batch job to compute candidate profiles (E4M3 vs E5M2) and surface top-k risky layers
Runtime: add selector feature flag that evaluates model-level profile confidence at load time and sets execution profile
Fallback: add sentinel detector in serving runtime that watches eval metric windows and flips to fallback profile with audit log
Integrations: store sensitivity artifacts in model-metadata store, push selector decisions to config service, and add dashboard panels
Testing: run golden-suite comparisons and create canary pool with traffic mirroring for 48h
test_plan: Unit tests: selector edge cases (zero variance, NaNs, extreme skew)
Integration: calibration-service -> model-metadata store -> runtime selection (local cluster)
Golden-suite: run nightly 200-model comparison, report top regressors and per-prompt diffs
Canary: 10% traffic mirroring for 48h; automated rollback if >0.5% accuracy drop or 5% latency p95 increase
Chaos test: simulate intermittent kernel OOM on hopper to validate fallback path and ensure no crash-loop
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal dev-only runs on small sample models (DONE)
Phase 1: limited canary (10% of canary capacity) with mirrored traffic for 48h
Phase 2: broaden canary to 25% after 72h with manual review from SRE/ML
Phase 3: gradual ramp to 100% on dedicated pools with automated monitoring and rollback hooks
Emergency: immediate circuit-breaker that unpins FP8 and reverts to last known-good quantization profile if sentinel triggered
telemetry_queries: fp8.runtime.fallback_rate: rate per minute, broken down by region and model
golden.eval.delta_top1: pct change vs baseline over rolling 24h
latency.p95.by_profile: compare E4M3/E5M2/FP16 under same load
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Activation sampler underestimates tails on low-frequency prompts -> Mitigation: add targeted high-tail prompt augmentation and stress sampling mode
Risk: Selector oscillates during model drift -> Mitigation: hysteresis windows + cooldown before re-enabling E4M3
Risk: Telemetry gaps during high load -> Mitigation: local fallback logging with eventual ingestion and safe defaults to E5M2
Risk: Canary traffic not representative -> Mitigation: include production traffic mirroring and synthetic adversarial prompts
dependencies_notes: Relies on calibration-service endpoints added in ENG-31247 and the per-op telemetry hooks from ENG-48123. Also needs runtime kernel gating work in runtime-1.20 branch.
